question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

If you had consulted me, I would have ______ you.
solution:
The correct answer is **'advised'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the form of **'Past Perfect Tense+would have+v3'. **
 
• It belongs to the **'Third Conditional Sentence'.**** **
 
 
• **E.g.__**- If you had helped me, I would have helped you.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• A **conditional sentence** is based on the word 'if'.
 
• There are always two parts to a conditional sentence – one part beginning with 'if' to describe a possible situation and the second part which describes the consequence.
 
 
• **For example**__: If it rains, we'll get wet.
